report_select_policies.name: reports_archived_select
report_select_policies.definition: (( SELECT private.current_business_user_is_active() AS current_business_user_is_active) AND ((deleted_at IS NOT NULL) OR (archived_at IS NOT NULL)) AND (( SELECT private.current_system_permission() AS current_system_permission) = 'admin'::text))

report_select_policies.name: reports_active_select
report_select_policies.definition: (( SELECT private.current_business_user_is_active() AS current_business_user_is_active) AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND ((( SELECT private.current_system_permission() AS current_system_permission) = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'leader'::text])) OR ( SELECT private.can_read_report(reports.shift_id, reports.submitted_by) AS can_read_report)))
